name: Agent plans a campaign and builds it on a canvas
looks: A caption describes the ask ("Describe it. The agent builds it.") beside an empty node canvas and a chat panel. The agent's reply lists a short checklist of planned shots; as each checklist item is confirmed, a connected node appears on the canvas and fills in with its generated image, the nodes linking into a small campaign tree.
build: Checklist items in the chat tick from pending to checked on their own beat; each check cues exactly one node to appear on the canvas (`scale 0.9 -> 1`, power2.out) connected by a drawn line to its parent node. The node's image resolves via a short placeholder-to-result cross-fade once it appears.
sound: A soft low pad under the chat, a light pop per checklist item confirming, a quiet whoosh as each node's connecting line draws on.
prompt: Beside a chat panel, let an agent's reply lay out a short checklist of planned outputs, and as each item confirms, grow a connected node on an open canvas that fills in with its own generated result, so a whole small campaign visibly assembles itself as a linked tree.
